templates.title: qPCR ΔΔCt, duplicate wells
templates.description: Relative expression from a 384-well qPCR run with target and housekeeping genes in duplicate. Averages replicates, then computes ΔCt, ΔΔCt against the control wells, relative expression and percent of control, with a per-well report.
templates.notes: Contains an unrelated embedded model (startup_captable) that roughly doubles its size.

templates.title: qPCR ΔΔCt, single wells

templates.title: Nonclinical development of individualized ASOs
templates.description: Seventeen milestones over about seven months: therapeutic goal, chemistry class, in vitro and in vivo proof of concept, off-target analysis, hybridization-independent toxicity, a single general tox study with FDA input, and hERG considerations.
templates.name: Nonclinical-Development-of-Individualized-ASOs.ljp

preview: Define therapeutic goal and mechanism – confirm disease-causing variant and proposed molecular target
Classify the ASO chemistry – ensure it falls within well-characterized categories (e.g. MOE-phosphorothioate)
Generate in vitro proof-of-concept (POC) – target knockdown or splice modulation using patient-derived cells
Confirm activity in vivo (if feasible) – use appropriate animal models or ASO-transfected tissues
Conduct BLAST or similar analysis – assess hybridization-dependent off-target risks
Evaluate hybridization-independent toxicity – infer from known class effects of similar ASOs
